name: cable kneeling one arm lat pulldown
description: A one arm lat pulldown from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and tests your core control.
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the arm rise back up slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
